context: Daichi and Riku recount a wild festival day.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (死ぬ/死ん/爆/がんばっ/かける) in natural home.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 昨日の祭り、死ぬほど盛り上がったなあ!
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、最後まで一生懸命がんばったね。
lines.en: Yeah, we gave it our all to the end.
lines.style: enthusiastic teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 司会のネタで、みんな爆笑しとったわ。
lines.en: Everyone cracked up at the MC's jokes.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 準備に、何日もかけたもんね。
lines.style: animated teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 照明が途中で死んだけど、なんとかなったわ。
lines.en: The lights died midway, but it worked out.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 電気が死んだ時、ヒヤッとしたよ。
lines.en: When the power died, I got chills.
lines.style: rueful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: みんながんばって、乗り切ったなあ。
lines.en: Everyone worked hard and pulled through.
lines.style: warm Kansai man voice, warm proud delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 来年も、時間かけて準備しようね!
lines.en: Let's spend time prepping next year too!
lines.style: eager teen boy voice, bright warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
